purpose: Materialize, as a repository-native record, the RE-U1 read-only UX/UI delta audit performed against the current materialized product, per the controlling RE-U0 delta reconciliation. Records measured findings only; creates no product authority, implements nothing, reopens nothing.
scope_note: DERIVED TRACKING RECORD. This artifact does not rewrite, supersede, reinterpret or restate any FIB, PC-01B, IM-01B, ODS or RE_U0 artifact; those remain byte-identical and controlling. It records the RE-U1 audit findings and a coordinator disposition layer only. It is not frozen product authority.

layer_separation.CURRENT_REPO_REALITY: What RE-U1 measured in the current materialized product at base_sha/base_tree.
layer_separation.PRESERVED_PRODUCT_TARGET: The prior frozen product/brand/commercial decision that remains controlling as the target, per RE-U0 Q1-Q6 dispositions.
layer_separation.FIB_DEPENDENCY: Findings whose functional completeness depends on a later FIB wave's technical contracts, not on UX/UI work in this lineage.
layer_separation.VISUAL_EVIDENCE_DEPENDENCY: Findings that cannot be adjudicated to an exact screen treatment until the Q5 evidence-recovery backlog resolves.
layer_separation.COORDINATOR_ADJUDICATION: A disposition layer added at materialization time that separates a SAFE_NOW explanation-surface delta from a WAIT_FOR_LATER_FIB functional dependency, without altering the original measured severity.

coordinator_adjudication.statement: This layer separates SAFE_NOW explanation-surface deltas from FIB-dependent functional completeness. It does not alter the original measured severity field of any finding, and it does not convert an implementation gap into an open HPO question.

U1_F16_disposition.binding_rule: A U5 not-found.tsx improvement MUST NOT be recorded later as restoring public verification functionality. The underlying fail-closed behavior (RE-U0-F1) is correct and FIB-dependent; only the explanation surface is SAFE_NOW.

execution_disposition.worktree_rationale: U5 and U6 both write components/layout/*.tsx (Sidebar/MobileNav need both the nav fix and the token migration). U3/U4 are documentation-only. Measured shared write surface is small and overlapping; merge cost exceeds parallelism benefit.
SAFE_NOW_U4: current onboarding dead-end remediation semantics (U1-F01 journey framing)
WAIT_FOR_WAVE2: Measure page/template architecture dependent on FIBIU-04..18 methodology objects
WAIT_FOR_LATER_FIB: Portfolio governed aggregation (Wave 5, FIBIU-27; Wave 6, FIBIU-30)
WAIT_FOR_VISUAL_EVIDENCE: any exact screen treatment depending on unrecovered VECP/HPO artifacts (Q5 backlog, 16 not_recovered / 1 partially_identified)
